dhikrLaIlahaMeaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone; His is the dominion and praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent
dhikrSubhanallahiWaBihamdihiMeaning: Glory be to Allah, and praise Him
dhikrSalawatMeaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
dhikrHawqalaMeaning: There is no power nor might except with Allah
dhikrAllahuAkbarSource: 34× after each prayer, completing the 100 — Sahih Muslim 596
dhikrSalawatSource: No fixed number in an authentic hadith — recite it often, as much as you wish
dhikrHawqalaSource: No fixed number in an authentic hadith — a "treasure of Paradise," recite it often
